correctness.rationale: Identified X_m exactly with connected crown graph on a_i,b_j with i!=j, graph cycle lattice all integer edge flows with vanishing row and column sums (rank m^2-3m+1). Fundamental graph cycles generate integrally; chord cutting reduces every >=8 cycle to shorter ones, and every six-cycle splits into four-cycles with a fourth label. For m>=5 every four-cycle has the same coinvariant image and the exact five-label relation Gamma(a,b;c,d)+Gamma(a,b;d,e)=Gamma(a,b;c,e) kills it. At m=4, six four-cycles have a unit 5x5 minor, rank-five lattice and a primitive relation (1,-1,1,1,-1,1); parity gives a nontrivial Z2 coinvariant and row swapping makes it at most Z2. For m=3 the crown is C6 and S3 acts by sign on H1. Independent symbolic minor, relation and integral SNF tests corroborate m=4, and the submitted finite verifier checks m<=8; the all-m proof is the lattice generation and five-label identity.
